result.rationale: The diff shows `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...))` at app-credential.ts with no try/catch or safeParse (unlike the zod body schema which at least throws a known zod error). Malformed ciphertext or a misconfigured CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY causes symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse to throw, yielding an unhandled 500 instead of a 4xx error response. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; severity is moderate since the endpoint requires the webhook secret.
